meta.title: eRFX Auction stage, Mark all mandatory: the vendor accepts one of the two clauses

plan.title: Mandatory T&C blocks partial vendor acceptance

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen with the default Auction stage.
Provide the required event title so the event can be published.
Apply an Auction template before adding line items.
Add the item that will receive the vendor quote.
Populate the Auction pricing sheet so the event is publishable.

args.goal: On the Auction stage, open Terms & Conditions, add exactly the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory", confirm both clauses show "Overridden by Mark all mandatory", and click Done; stop on the create screen

steps.note: Configure the two required clauses and verify the mandatory override behavior, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Invite the available QA vendor that will submit the quote.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the event's Auction pricing round and its bid form as the vendor.
Verify the first mandatory clause is visible to the vendor.
Verify the second mandatory clause is visible to the vendor.
Accept only one of the two mandatory clauses.
Attempt to submit a quote of 100; the submission must be blocked because the second mandatory clause remains unaccepted.
